name: Ember Spark
description: Ignites tinder, warms metal, and delivers a brief sting of fire.

name: Stone Grip
description: Strengthens footing, handhold, and bracing force against loose ground or impact.

name: Watershape
description: Draws, gathers, cleans, or redirects a small quantity of water into useful form.

name: Breath of Frost
description: Cools surfaces and objects, preserves perishables, and leaves a film of rime or slick ice.

name: Storm Jolt
description: Discharges a sharp spark that startles nerves, powers a minor mechanism, or interrupts concentration.

name: Scouring Flame
description: Projects a directed tongue of fire to burn foes, sterilize filth, or clear obstructing growth.

name: Earthen Bulwark
description: Raises a wall, berm, ramp, or slab of compacted earth and stone for cover and control.

name: Torrent Lash
description: Whips water into a striking or shoving form that batters targets and douses flame.

name: Gale Step
description: Uses compressed wind to leap farther, break falls, dart through danger, or shove bodies off balance.

name: Lightning Lance
description: Calls a focused bolt of storm force that pierces armor, machinery, and clustered enemies.

name: Magma Vein
description: Heats and splits the ground with searing force, creating molten hazards and broken footing.

name: Winter's Grasp
description: Spreads hard freeze across a substantial area, locking structures, slowing forces, and trapping targets in ice-rimed stillness.

name: Storm Front
description: Conjures a roaming mass of wind, rain, thunder, lightning, and reduced visibility under the caster's control.

name: Earthwake
description: Heaves terrain into ridges, trenches, pillars, and fissures, redrawing movement and line of sight across a wide area.

name: Cataclysm Accord
description: The supreme elemental convergence: storm, quake, flood, frost, and flame answer a single will and remake the scene in raw primal violence.
